label: Condition Barrier Type
description: What kind of barrier, milestone, or event a Grant Condition's entitlement, payment, continuation, release, or retention depends on.

values.label: Matching Requirement
values.definition: Contingent on raising or contributing matching funds.

values.label: Cost-Sharing Requirement
values.definition: Contingent on sharing costs alongside the award.

values.label: Output Threshold
values.definition: Contingent on reaching a specified output count.

values.label: Service-Level Threshold
values.definition: Contingent on reaching a specified service level.

values.label: Outcome Threshold
values.definition: Contingent on reaching a specified outcome level.

values.label: Performance Milestone
values.definition: Contingent on reaching a defined performance milestone.

values.label: Specified Event
values.definition: Contingent on a specified event occurring.

values.label: Specified Protocol
values.definition: Contingent on following a specified protocol.

values.label: Specified Method
values.definition: Contingent on using a specified method.

values.label: Specified Personnel
values.definition: Contingent on specified personnel being engaged.

values.label: Fundraising Target
values.definition: Contingent on reaching a fundraising target.

values.label: Other Measurable Barrier
values.definition: Contingent on another measurable barrier not otherwise listed.

values.label: Other
values.definition: A condition barrier not captured by another value in this scheme.
